# astryx.Component { #anylumino.astryx.Component }

```python
astryx.Component(
    component_name,
    children=None,
    *,
    props=None,
    text='',
    label='',
    **kwargs,
)
```

Render a registered Astryx component by name.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type                        | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | Default    |
|----------------|-----------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| component_name | str                         | Frontend Astryx component name registered in the anylumino bridge.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | _required_ |
| children       | ChildInput                  | Child widget, sequence of widgets, or mapping of slot names to widgets.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | `None`     |
| props          | Mapping\[str, Any\] \| None | Additional JSON-safe props for the selected Astryx component. Unsafe React keys such as ``children``, ``dangerouslySetInnerHTML``, ``ref``, and ``key`` are filtered by the frontend bridge. Component data props such as ``items`` are preserved. See the Astryx docs for the selected component page, for example <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/Blockquote>. | `None`     |
| text           | str                         | Text content synchronized to the frontend.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | `''`       |
| label          | str                         | Visible or accessible component label.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | `''`       |
